rationale: Mouse genome-wide KO screen (~90,000 guides, up to 5 per gene, no non-targeting controls in the library) during female NPC-to-iPSC reprogramming. The deposited MAGeCK count workbook has one count column per sorted population (NPC, non-pluripotent, early pluripotent, late/X-reactivated pluripotent); the two biological reprogramming rounds were pooled, so there is one library per condition and the no-replicate path applies (pooled overdispersion over all guides, zero residual df). Counts are raw integers. The paper (MAGeCK RRA) compares early vs non-pluripotent (activators of early pluripotency deplete, negative LFC) and late vs early pluripotent (drivers of late pluripotency / X-reactivation deplete); both are reproduced, plus late vs NPC. There are no non-targeting controls, so calibration and a control null cannot be built; with one library per condition these are screening-level calls.
